steps.title: Open Triple
steps.body: An Open Triple is similar to the Open Pair, but uses three cells instead of two. Look for three cells in the same unit that collectively contain exactly three candidates between them.

steps.title: Find the Triple
steps.body: In the bottom-left box, three cells share candidates 1, 4, and 8. They form our Open Triple. Those candidates can't appear anywhere else in the unit.

steps.title: Open Triple
steps.body: Just like the Open Pair, selecting the evidence cells will automatically remove the candidates from the puzzle!

steps.title: Finish the Puzzle
steps.body: There's one more Open Triple to wrap this puzzle. Hint: All three cells do not need to have all three candidates! Tap the hint button at the bottom to find it if you're stumped.
